sentences.en: The Southern Cross is not to be seen in Japan.
sentences.zh: 在日本看不到南方十字星。

sentences.en: In Southern China, the qipao is also known as "changshan".
sentences.zh: 在中国南部，旗袍也被称为长衫。

sentences.en: The Southern Ocean is considered the world's most treacherous ocean.
sentences.zh: 南大洋被认为是世界上最危险的大洋之一。
